connector.name: Norvstar - Professional Identity MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Query professional profiles, search candidates, and get AI-powered summaries and job fit analysis.
connector.summary: Hosted at norvstar.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.norvstar, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
